about: The falsifier: a zoom that takes a value for the place. Seen from inside obligations, a scope that spelled obligations at any depth lost it, so the import specifier @lapxo/obligations/views/field in obligations' receipts reached the published folder as @lapxo/views/field. learn.ts found no call into @lapxo/obligations, and four learn pages lost their intro and the graph of what they rest on.
